info.name: Apache Nutch REST Admin Reader API
Apache Nutch Read a Sequence File

params.name: nrows
params.description: Number of rows to read. If not specified (or -1), all rows are returned.

params.name: start
params.description: Starting line number for a range read.

params.name: end
params.description: Ending line number for a range read.

params.name: count
params.description: If true, returns the number of lines instead of the data itself. When set, the response content type is text/plain.

items.docs: Reads key-value pairs from a Hadoop sequence file. Supports reading all rows, a limited number of rows, a row range, or counting the total number of rows.
